description:
Revision 6's cost projection, from development timings only (SPEC_V3.md R3-C7).

Usage::

    python -m nac_bench.timing_v6 [--out results_v3/timing_pilot/projection_v6.json]

Revision 6 adds work that revision 5's projection (``projection_v5.json``) did not cover:
every placement simulated on FakeBerlin at d=5, a larger best-found set on the other
square-lattice cases (1,000 uniform placements and six top-30 lists), the d=3 surface code,
the directional setting on nine cases, the isolation references' choices at the family's
shots, the grading variants, the detection rate on every placement and the Qiskit level 2
seed sweep. As in ``timing_v5``, each new cost is a ratio measured here, in one process,
times a cost the second timing pilot measured on patty (``timing_pilot_2.json``), and the
devices measured are development devices only (X16): FakeFez for the heavy-hex repetition
codes, FakeMiami for the square lattice and, with its removed couplers restored (R3-S3),
for the surface code. FakeMiami's d=5 repetition P_L gives a second, square-lattice estimate
of FakeBerlin D5's shots; R3-C5's every-placement guard bounds that case whatever its P_L.

largest_single_case.case: berlin-D7 and nighthawk-D7 selection, one setting, with the idle-aware summed error and the detection rate

lines.note: 345408 placements (upper bound), the larger of FakeFez's and FakeMiami's P_L (521 and 616 core-hours); R3-C5's guard caps each setting at 24 wall hours

lines.item: square-lattice best-found set, D7 and FakeNighthawk D5
lines.note: at most 1202 placements per case, up from 198

lines.item: d=3 surface code (S3), FakeBerlin and FakeNighthawk
lines.note: 768 candidates per device (FakeMiami restored's count, an estimate); family placements at the family's shots; FakeBerlin's re-decoded
selection again on every placement; every choice here and at the headline setting simulated, the family placements of both at the family's shots

lines.item: isolation references' choices at the family's shots
lines.note: two more family placements per repetition case, one per surface case, with their re-decode and d-round memory
every variant on at most 7 family placements per confirmatory case, 3 seeds, other placements' shots
65 cases x 10 transpiles, each bounded by 8 s; its choices are simulated with the best-found set or every placement

notes: development timings only: patty's second pilot, times ratios measured here on FakeFez and FakeMiami (X16), and revision 5's ratios (projection_v5.json)
placement counts are coupling-map upper bounds; P_L from FakeFez (repetition), FakeMiami (FakeBerlin D5's second estimate) and FakeMiami restored (surface)
FakeBerlin D7 at the directional setting is a third selection of 12.8M placements, so FakeBerlin's three D7 selections are three cases of about 7.6 wall hours each
the scaled score's and the detection rate's seconds are this machine's, not scaled to patty
